title: Age of Epoch
description: An unofficial Fabric port of Age of Exile for Minecraft 26.3: a Russian-localized hack-and-slash RPG with skills, spells, loot, dungeons, towers, professions, and dynamic balancing.
body:
# Age of Epoch

Age of Epoch is a Russian-localized, hack-and-slash RPG overhaul for **Minecraft Java Edition 26.3** on **Fabric**. This is an unofficial community port of [Age of Exile](https://github.com/RobertSkalko/Age-of-Exile), maintained in this repository. It is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft, Fabric, or the upstream project authors.

## Features

- Character progression with attributes, talent trees, spells, equipment, affixes, loot, and crafting professions.
- Dungeons, expeditions, themed towers, Divine Missions, a questbook, and an in-game wiki.
- Optional JEI integration for profession recipes and related crafting information.
- Russian localization and the GameMaster progression and balance systems.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition **26.3**.
- **Java 25** or newer.
- **Fabric Loader 0.19.5** or newer and **Fabric API 0.163.0+26.3** or newer.
- **Trinkets Updated 4.2.1+26.3**.

Install this mod and its required dependencies on both the client and server. Place the JARs in the `mods` folder.

## Controls

The hub uses **H**, the questbook uses **K**, and the compact party HUD uses **O** to toggle and **P** to cycle its position. Spell and other keybinds can be changed in Minecraft's Controls settings.

## Source, issues, and attribution

- Source code and issue tracker: [Antoniumu/Age-of-Epoch](https://github.com/Antoniumu/Age-of-Epoch).
- Upstream project: [RobertSkalko/Age-of-Exile](https://github.com/RobertSkalko/Age-of-Exile).

# Эпоха (русский)

Русская локализация и RPG-порт Age of Exile для Minecraft 26.3 на Fabric: характеристики, таланты, заклинания, экипировка, аффиксы, профессии, подземелья, башни, миссии и внутриигровой квестбук. Это неофициальный порт; исходный проект указан в разделе атрибуции.
